{{Quote|That navigator of yours! Why isn't he ''dead''?|Devore Korsin, to Yaru Korsin, referring to Boyle Marcom|<ref name="precipice" />}}
'''Boyle Marcom''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigation officer]] who served for [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] as part of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the then-aged and physically frail Marcom was selected as the [[Helm officer/Legends|helmsman]] for a [[Lignan crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and [[Transport/Legends|transport]] mission by [[Yaru Korsin]], the son of [[Eldrak Korsin]], an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] under whom Marcom had served in the past. However, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]] nudged Marcom's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', off course as it jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ''Omen'' crashed on an uncharted [[Kesh/Legends|planet]], and the blame was laid squarely at Marcom's feet by some of the ship's crew. After surviving the crash, Marcom was confronted and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by miner [[Devore Korsin]], Yaru Korsin's brother.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You don't know my job! I did all that I could!|Boyle Marcom, to Devore Korsin|<ref name="precipice" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Boyle Marcom served in the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] as a [[Helm officer/Legends|helmsman]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before and during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Marcom began [[Navigator/Legends|navigating]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] during the middle of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]]'s reign, and continued under Ragnos's successor, [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Sadow led an invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large&mdash;the Great Hyperspace War&mdash;and Boyle Marcom served as part of the [[Sith invasion fleet|Sith fleet]]. That year, Marcom joined the crew of the<ref name="precipice" /> [[Sith dreadnaught]]<ref name="crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> ''[[Omen]]'', serving as the navigation [[Officer/Legends|officer]] for a mission to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] and [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Lignan crystal]]s<ref name="precipice" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaegon III]]'s [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]].<ref name="crosscurrent" />

The mission was commanded by [[Yaru Korsin]], the son of [[Eldrak Korsin]], an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] under whom Marcom had previously served. Although Marcom had not been at his best in years, his relationship with the elder Korsin was what drove Yaru to select him as helmsman for the Lignan expedition. However, as the ''Omen'' was about to depart Phaegon III to deliver the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] to the planet [[Kirrek]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attacked]] the ''Omen'' and its sister ship, the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']].<ref name="precipice" /> During the skirmish, one of the Jedi, [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Drev Hassin]], [[Death/Legends|suicidally]] crashed his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] into the ''Harbinger''.<ref name="crosscurrent" /> Although Marcom was able to get the ''Omen'' to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the ''Harbinger'' nudged the ship off-course. The ''Omen'' was badly damaged by a [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] in hyperspace, which pulled the ship back into [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] near an [[Kesh/Legends|uncharted planet]]. As Marcom fiddled with his controls, trying to fix the problem, he was confronted by a furious member of the mining team, Yaru Korsin's brother, [[Devore Korsin]].<ref name="precipice" />

Devore was stopped before he could do any harm to Marcom, and the ''Omen'' drifted into the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], where the frail Marcom was thrown about the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] by rushing winds. Injured but not dead, Marcom survived the ''Omen''{{'s}} crash in a [[Takara Mountains|mountain range]] and the treacherous journey from the ship's wreckage to the valley below. Although they had gotten through the ordeal, Devore's rage at Marcom did not diminish. Korsin gathered several of his miners and confronted Marcom, blaming him for the ship's crash while the miners held the helmsman back. Marcom tried to defend himself, but to no avail&mdash;the furious and high-on-[[Spice/Legends|spice]] Korsin ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and killed him, his own lightsaber rolling harmlessly to Yaru Korsin's feet.<ref name="precipice" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oh, what's the use talking to&hellip;|Boyle Marcom, referring to Devore Korsin|<ref name="precipice" />}}
Boyle Marcom was mild-mannered and timid by Sith standards, and he was physically frail by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Great Hyperspace War. Marcom became frustrated when arguing with a being he saw as intractable or irrational, as was the case with Devore Korsin.
He owned a lightsaber, which could imply he was also a Force-sensitive. Moments before his death, at the hands of Devore Korsin, he was accused of using it to attack first.<ref name="precipice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boyle Marcom first appeared in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'', a [[2009]] [[eBook]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="precipice" />
